anchorAudit.rationale: The five ground-floor areas were checked on the atrium photograph. Each mapped object or visible part has its own image bounds. The word index also includes equipment, concealed parts and alternate names without a distinct visible object in the overview.

visualRegions.description: Complete warm office atrium showing reception, open work floor, conference room, pantry and service core
The illuminated wall directory, hanging lights and curved wood reception counter at the left of the atrium.
Two rows of desks, screens, task chairs and drawer cabinets behind the curved reception counter.
The freestanding glass enclosure in the centre of the ground floor, with a wood meeting table and dark chairs.
The kitchenette beside the glass enclosure, with pendant lights, open shelves, counter stools and a round dining table.
The lift doors and open stairway on the right, with exposed ducts above and server cabinets beneath the stairs.
Bright visible elevator, stairwell and building-service core on the office atrium photograph
Meeting table and chair backs inside the central glass enclosure on the ground floor of the office atrium. An agent reviewed this entrance against the atrium image.
Rear workstation screens, desktops and chair backs behind the reception counter.
The fluted wood face of the curved reception counter in the left foreground.
Visible kitchenette counter, sink, dish rack and nearby seating within the office-building photograph.
